review.verdict: Cast and basic read are sound (human exec and parents, robot correctly stands for the chatbot), but a flagged clipping bug, a disconnected briefcase, a robot crowded between parents instead of blocked at a door, and a composition very close to recent blueprint-splits pull the average below the bar.
revisionNotes: Pull parent-two in from x=0.86 toward ~0.80 and trim the pointing-arm length; lint already flags it clipping the safe area at x 843-1069.
Attach the briefcase to exec's hand (attachTo: exec, side: right) instead of floating it near the door as a separate icon — right now it reads as an unrelated prop.
Move the robot to stand at the schoolhouse threshold in front of the parents rather than sandwiched between them, so the 'blocked at the door' beat actually reads.
Render the company door as an open leaf (angled panel) rather than a closed flat rectangle — the brief calls for a door swinging open, but it reads as shut.
Add a visible door/opening to the schoolhouse shape so 'door only partly open' is legible, not just windows.

This split blueprint layout (building + crashing chart one side, human+robot the other) is close in composition and palette to two recent sloppers; try a stacked or diagonal layout, or a different accent color, for freshness.
